classes.derivation_evidence: Anthropic 2024-10-22: October snapshot is an upgrade of Claude 3.5 Sonnet checkpoint; vendor states price and speed match. Primary https://www.anthropic.com/news/3-5-models-and-computer-use (retrieved 2026-09-07).
classes.reference_configuration_compatibility: UNRESOLVED. June YAML has no effort/reasoning block. October YAML: reasoning false, default_effort_tier default. Both fitted only as @max-common; that fit label does not document shared vendor effort control. October also adds computer-use. Under standard-trait estimand, both represent non-thinking checkpoints, but reference configuration is uncertified.
classes.notes: Relationship-supported candidate component. original_component_id=claude-3.5-sonnet-snapshots. Provenance in metadata.components.

classes.derivation_evidence: Anthropic 2025-08-05: Opus 4.1 is an upgrade of Opus 4; listed price unchanged; developers told to switch the API identifier. Primary https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-opus-4-1 (retrieved 2026-09-07).
classes.reference_configuration_compatibility: UNRESOLVED. Opus 4 YAML has no effort or reasoning block. Opus 4.1 YAML documents standard/extended-thinking with numeric thinking.budget_tokens. While effort nuisance delta accounts for max effort gain under standard-trait estimand, Opus 4 is fixed effort (delta=0) whereas Opus 4.1 is variable effort; baseline reference configuration uncertified.
classes.notes: Relationship-supported candidate component. original_component_id=claude-opus-4-drop-in. Kept separate from Sonnet 4. Provenance in metadata.components.

classes.reference_configuration_compatibility: UNRESOLVED. Sonnet 4 YAML documents standard/extended-thinking with a numeric thinking budget. Sonnet 4.5 YAML has no effort/reasoning block. Drop-in language and @max-common co-assignment do not certify matched baseline configurations.
classes.notes: Relationship-supported candidate component. original_component_id=claude-sonnet-4-drop-in. Provenance in metadata.components.
